newsitem.title: CANADA: Corriente drops on Peru drill results.
newsitem.headline: Corriente drops on Peru drill results.

text.p: Corriente Resources Inc stock fell sharply Tuesday after the company announced that no significant gold intercepts were found in the first four drill holes at its Chama project in southern Peru.
Corriente stock declined 3.70 to 6.45 in Toronto making it the biggest loser of the day. Nearly 768,000 shares traded.
"Assays indicate the presence of widespread but low-grade gold mineralization. No significant intersections of potential ore grade core were reported," Corriente said earlier.

Corriente vice president Henk van Alphen said Corriente still believes in the project's potential despite "unfortunate" results from the first four holes. He attributed the stock fall to investor nervousness after the scandal over Bre-X Minerals Ltd.
"This is a very normal situation" for an exploration property, he said. "Unfortunately we are in a very jittery market. It's very irrational behavior"
Corriente plans to drill up to 30 holes in a large anomalous area. "It's a fantastic looking property," van Alphen said.
